purpose: Materialize one exact simulated visual thought into a local static-web artifact using separate but mutually required shape, material, color, light, shade and skin channels, so the specialist builds from the same scene state that produced the cinematic simulation.

properties.path: output project directory outside the live machine body or under creations/
properties.simulation: exact AXM simulation result with status NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS, thought, thought_digest and matching cinematic projection
properties.replace: optional explicit replacement of an existing creation target

contains: proof that the cinematic projection equals the materialized SVG scene

relationships: acts as the specialist that pulls an inspectable simulated thought into a real project artifact
requires shape, material, color, light, shade and skin as distinct composition channels for every visual object
uses the same deterministic renderer for simulation projection and materialization instead of asking a second builder to reinterpret the idea
accepts open material names while rendering the currently declared metallic, roughness, opacity, emission, light, shade and skin parameters

anatomy_refs.basis: The specialist renders the exact visual scene state into an inspectable SVG body and local project.
Surface, light, shade, skin and color remain separate compositional inputs rather than being flattened into one opaque style string.

limitations: the current materializer is an SVG/static-web renderer, not a physically accurate 3D or ray-traced renderer
open material names do not prove physical material behavior; only the explicitly rendered parameters are carried into reality
matching simulation and materialized SVG proves exact transfer for the current scene grammar, not perfect prediction of browser, physical or human-perception outcomes
animation, texture files, external assets and arbitrary shader code are not part of this v0 Paintgun grammar
persistent_state: only the caller-selected materialized creation directory persists

truth.basis: The specialist rechecks the exact thought digest and requires the final cinematic SVG to equal the materialized SVG source.

agency.basis: Visual channels remain explicit and independently changeable; the specialist does not hide or reinterpret the simulated design.

continuity.basis: Materialization creates an ordinary inspectable project and does not modify the live machine body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Reality materialization is allowed only after the simulator reaches its explicit current stop state and the exact thought/projection binding still holds.
